Alex: Quick mock for a 'Path Playback' view in the Console that shows the routing decision path for a request — headers we set, predicate checks (tier, region, quota), capacity gates, and the final model variant chosen (and any fallback). Wanted early feedback before I wire up the API. :eyes:

Priya: Really nice. Can we surface cost delta when fallback happens and per-request quota burn? That's what product will ask for.

Jamal: Agree on headers. We already pass some but we should standardize. Suggest we include:

``
X-Rw-Tier: enterprise
X-Rw-Region: eu-west-1
X-Rw-Model-Variant: gptj-14b-q4
X-Rw-Fallback-Reason: cap-exhausted
X-Rw-Decision-Trace: dt_1842106789-1
``

Also include the name of the matching predicate, e.g. `latency_pref_v2`.

Erin: Sampling question — storing full decision traces for every request is expensive. Recommend default sample 1% globally + per-customer override. TTL 7 days for traces, and index by trace id + model variant for fast lookup.

Lucas: UX ideas: scrubber timeline showing evaluation steps (tier check -> region affinity -> quota gate -> capacity -> final choice). Show raw headers and a link to 'raw trace' JSON. Add 'Replay in sandbox' button (with permission guard) so support can reproduce routing.

Priya: Also show quota numbers before/after and an estimated cost delta (tokens * model-rate) when fallback occurs. For enterprise customers show historical fallback rate.

Alex: Minimal server work: return a response header so SDKs/clients can correlate: `X-Rw-Decision-Id: dt_1842106789-1`. Console calls GET `/api/decision_traces/<id>` to render. No change to existing request flow.

Jamal: Small caveat — don't leak internal kernel/quantization labels to customers. Store opaque variant ids for public UI; keep internal mapping in logs.

Erin: From infra: add config flag `enable_path_playback: false` default. Also add privacy audit note (PII scrubber) before storing payloads.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: alex/path-playback canary -> live :rocket:

Alex: I'll open the API PR with schema + sampling config and mock screenshots. Thanks everyone :+1:
